weapon_purchase.text: Bought {item} for {cost} coins. The Gear Weirdo said it 'has a destiny.' The destiny was not specified.
Purchased {item} for {cost} coins. The Gear Weirdo swore it only had one previous owner and 'barely any incidents.'
Acquired {item} for {cost} coins. The receipt is longer than the warranty.
Bought {item} for {cost} coins. It hummed once during the handoff. The Gear Weirdo called that 'enthusiasm.'

weapon_equip.text: Equipped {item} for the next deployment. The raider approved the vibes.
Strapped on {item}. Performed the traditional pre-raid pep talk to the equipment. The equipment stayed neutral.
Equipped {item} and practiced one heroic pose in the locker mirror. The mirror has seen worse. Barely.

weapon_repair.text: Repaired {item} for {cost} coins. The maintenance budget cried quietly.
Repaired {item} for {cost} coins. The bench tech hit it twice, listened, and declared it 'basically new-adjacent.'
Paid {cost} coins to repair {item}. Asked about a warranty. The tech laughed until they needed water.

healing_purchase.text: Bought {quantity}x {item} for {cost} coins. Medicine is cheaper than regret.
Stocked {quantity}x {item} for {cost} coins. The med counter insists everything is 'sterile-ish.'
Bought {quantity}x {item} for {cost} coins from a shelf marked NEARLY FRESH. For medical supplies, that word choice is doing a lot of work.

shield_recharger_purchase.text: Bought {quantity}x {item} for {cost} coins. The shield budget called this proactive optimism.
Bought {quantity}x {item} for {cost} coins. The Bravado Battery Kiosk described each cell as 'courageous.' Batteries cannot be brave. These might be.
Picked up {quantity}x {item} for {cost} coins. One sparked during bagging. The kiosk called it a free demonstration.
